Question 6
?

Find the general solution of the Clairaut differential equation: y=xy′+ln⁡(y′),y′>0.

a
y=cx+c
b
y=ln⁡(c)x+c
c
y=−cx+ln⁡(c)
d
y=−cx+ln⁡(2c)
e
y=cx+ln⁡(c)
